requirements.text: Regulatory compliance is the top priority for any new features.
System must focus on PSD2 requirements, particularly around strong customer authentication.
System must comply with GDPR for data protection.
System must adhere to consumer protection rules from the Central Bank.
System must allow customers to manage their card statuses directly in the app.
System must allow customers to freeze and unfreeze their debit or credit cards directly in the app.
New features must integrate with existing systems without requiring major modifications.
Compliance with PSD2 and consumer protection regulations is non-negotiable for new features.
